about.heading: What are QR Codes?
about.description: QR (Quick Response) codes are two-dimensional barcodes that can be scanned using a smartphone camera. They store various types of information such as URLs, text, contact details, and more. Originally developed in Japan for tracking automotive parts, they've become ubiquitous for quickly sharing information.
